newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda forms power products venture in Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Honda forms power products venture in Indonesia.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it had formed a joint venture in Indonesia to produce and sell power products such as generators and water pumps from around June 1997.
PT Sinar Honda Jaya, capitalised at about 230 million yen, is 60 percent owned by Honda and 40 percent by PT Wajamakmur Mandiri of Indonesia, Honda said in a statement.
The venture, located in Chikampek in West Java, will produce general-purpose engines, generators and water pumps, Honda said.
Annual production will be more than 100,000 units, it said.
The products will be sold initially in Indonesia only, but could be exported elsewhere in Asia in the future, it said.
